She entreated him to stay for one more day.

definitions: sociable and enjoying the company of others
entries.example_sentence: Dolphins are known to be gregarious creatures.
an official formal accusation for a criminal offence The grand jury returned an indictment against the accused.
feeling or expressing strong displeasure at something unjust or offensive She was indignant at the way she was treated.
inescapable or inevitable Aging is an ineluctable process of life.
curious or eager to acquire knowledge Her inquisitive nature led her to explore various topics.
scope to do something; relative freedom from restrictions The manager gave him considerable latitude in making decisions.
humor or lightness, especially when inappropriate The levity in his speech was surprising given the serious occasion.
showing ill will or wishing harm to others The villain had a malevolent glare.
intervene between parties to bring about a resolution The counselor helped mediate the dispute between the siblings.
block or stop up; cover A blood clot can occlude an artery, causing serious health issues.
bring peace to or calm someone down The lullaby worked to pacify the crying baby.
a model of excellence or perfection She was seen as a paragon of virtue in the community.
